title: fix(spec)!: drop an explained bare union head from the data API fields[]
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As5bdhV5T4N9vpjmZzH

Fixes #35433

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skills/ page names the union's `invalid_shape` / `Invalid input` entry or reads `fields[]` by position

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:通过数据接口提交、在联合类型字段上被拒时,错误清单不再先列一条空洞的「输入无效」,第一条就是真正的原因;下面没有解释时那句仍保留。
- 为什么做:按维护者对这张卡的裁决(选项 A,跟元数据保存那边一样去掉),让数据接口和元数据保存两处对同一个值说同样的话。
- 出错会怎样:按位置读错误清单第一条、或专找那条「输入无效」的调用方会读到不同条目;普通的增删改和批量写入不受影响;不涉及存储数据,撤回这一个 PR 即可恢复。
- 要你做什么:批准或合并这个 PR;它是申报了收窄的破坏性改动,席位不能自己落地。

## What changes

`zodIssuesToFields` (`packages/spec/src/api/zod-issues-to-fields.ts`), the mapper behind every data-API `fields[]` refusal, now drops a failed union's own entry, `{ code: 'invalid_shape', message: 'Invalid input' }`, whenever an entry below it explains the failure, at every depth. It keeps that entry when nothing explains it (every branch a bare kind mismatch, or the depth bound reached), when it carries the schema's own `error` sentence, and for container heads (`invalid_key` / `invalid_element`). This is the rule the metadata envelope took for #35400, per the maintainer's ruling record 7010280743 on this card (option A, 「A 跟 #35400 一样去掉」).

- Producer: `collectIssueFields` gathers the expansion into a local list first, then pushes the head only when the list is empty or the head's message is not zod's exact default (`ZOD_UNION_DEFAULT_MESSAGE`, pinned against a real zod parse).
- Pins: `zod-issues-to-fields.test.ts` (new describe), `union-branch-policy.parity.test.ts` (the renderer keeps the head as the parent line of its tree; the wire drops it, asserted with a kept-head control), `union-branch-policy.cross-package-parity.test.ts` (the two machine lists now agree entry for entry), `packages/rest/src/zod-union-fields.test.ts` (the query door on the wire).
- Docs: `content/docs/api/error-handling-server.mdx` no longer teaches "that entry PLUS the entries of the branch".
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `fix(spec)!`, BREAKING banner, FROM / TO, one ADR-0087 marker (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

## Why

Ruled on this card: the data API's `fields[]` and the metadata envelope's `issues[]` say the same thing about one value. The head named only the slot; the entries naming the key and the constraint were always further down the list.

## Tests

The package-suite and ablation readings below are from head `38aa8786363`, taken under the shared verify lock on a shared box. Head `39597f014f7` (the rework: changeset and two docblocks, comment-only in code, plus a merge of `origin/main`) was re-read on the affected files; see Verification.

<details><summary>Package suites (all green)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 982 passed (982), Tests 29844 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 369 passed, 9 skipped (378), Tests 23389 passed, 45 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: Test Files 429 passed (429), Tests 8818 passed, 351 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter X typecheck` for spec, metadata-protocol and rest: exit 0 each.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one time, not kept)</summary>

- Mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the guard `if (below.length === 0 || message !== ZOD_UNION_DEFAULT_MESSAGE) out.push(entry);` was replaced with an unconditional `out.push(entry);` plus a marker comment, so the head is always kept again. The anchor count went 1 to 0, the marker count 0 to 1, and the blob changed from `9823123bd547` to `23c2523c7f98`.
- Mutated leg, `zod-issues-to-fields.test.ts` and `union-branch-policy.parity.test.ts`: Test Files 2 failed (2), Tests 11 failed, 31 passed (42). Among the failures: "a top-level union head is dropped, so fields[0] is the located cause", "every head of a nested union is dropped while something below explains it", and every "agrees pair for pair" fixture that has an explained head.
- Restore was proven by blob hash: the blob after restore equals the HEAD blob (`9823123bd547`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Restored leg: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 42 passed (42).
- Scope: these two suites import the source relatively, so they measure `src/` and need no rebuild. The metadata-protocol and rest pins resolve `@objectstack/spec` through `dist/`, and they were not ablated.
- The first attempt was a no-op, and the tool refused it: the replacement text is a substring of the anchor, so the replacement count did not rise. It was rerun with a marker.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Every shipped call site consumes the mapper unchanged and none re-adds the head, so none is touched: `crud-routes.ts` (create, find, update), `batch-routes.ts` (batch, createMany, updateMany, deleteMany), `record-page-routes.ts`, `rest-server.ts`, `analytics-selection-door.ts`, `plugin-auth`'s `personal-view-hooks.ts` and `types`' `validation-failure.ts`. All of them answer `VALIDATION_FAILED`.
- One in-repo reader reads by position: `readDeclaredQueryNumber` (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:926`) builds its sentence from `fields[0]?.message`. For a declared number schema that is a union with an explaining branch, that sentence now quotes the first located cause in place of "Invalid input". No regression.
- The prose renderer (`formatZodError`, the CLI) still prints the union line as the parent of its indented tree. That asymmetry is recorded in both parity tests.
- Read first, by risk: `packages/spec/src/api/zod-issues-to-fields.ts` (the `below` hunk in `collectIssueFields`), then `union-branch-policy.cross-package-parity.test.ts` §2/§4, then the changeset.
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/api/zod-issues-to-fields.test.ts` — expect every test green, including the describe "an explained bare union head is dropped".

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (CI-owned run).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (none moved).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
